scope: Sequential GPU-only diagnosis, one fixed 250-source cohort, order old/new/new-light. A single pass per arm and shared host conditions do not establish a statistically isolated source or tracing effect. CPU was not rerun.
observers: All arms retain identical container resource, Job-state, Work Source cursor and WSL host observers; light does not mean completely uninstrumented.

cohort.selection: Same first four cold inputs, then source indices 4 + i*996//246 for i in range(246) from the immutable ordered 1000-source cache.

cold_first_wave.scope: First four fresh source uploads through durable requested outputs, includes broker startup when lazily started; excludes deployment/API boot.

warm_remaining.scope: Remaining246 source files through durable outputs after cold first wave; descriptive subcohort, not a250-model claim.

upload_backpressure.policy: Only507 with exact staging_capacity_exceeded;1s backoff;30s perinput bounded by original run deadline; reopen local source each attempt.

memory.process_cpu_limitation: Sampled process CPU can miss short-lived workers and final exit increments; cgroup CPU is the authoritative complete-container counter. PID start ticks prevent reuse collisions. Per-process I/O remains unavailable; cgroup I/O is retained.

gpu.scope: Physical adapter including unrelated host activity; sampled, not per-process dedicated VRAM.

context_summary.scope: Linux WSL VM counters only; Windows host contention is not measured. Observer timestamps bound intervals between observed Job changes, not exact DB commit times.
